def format_currency_suffix(amount, code):
    negative = amount < 0
    cents = round(abs(amount) * 100)
    dollars, remainder = divmod(cents, 100)
    digits = str(dollars)
    groups = []
    while len(digits) > 3:
        groups.insert(0, digits[-3:])
        digits = digits[:-3]
    groups.insert(0, digits)
    with_commas = ','.join(groups)
    sign = '-' if negative else ''
    return f"{sign}{with_commas}.{remainder:02d} {code}"

def min_swaps_to_sort_by_abs_value(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: abs(arr[i]))
    current = list(arr)
    index_in_current = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(current)}
    swaps = 0
    for i in range(n):
        target_val = arr[order[i]]
        if current[i] != target_val:
            j = index_in_current[target_val]
            current[i], current[j] = current[j], current[i]
            index_in_current[current[i]] = i
            index_in_current[current[j]] = j
            swaps += 1
    return swaps
